metadata.note: Waterloo–Woking services from table 6, enriched by uniquely matching table 8 intermediate calls. Other SWR branches and trains passing Woking without a timing are excluded. Full origins/destinations are not established by these corridor tables. Temporary timetable and engineering alterations are not applied. Berrylands is closed in the source timetable. Single-sided calls have no invented dwell.
